parameters.name: MaxNumberOfPortMappings
parameters.description: The maximum number of port mappings that can exist at any given time. If the value of this parameter is 0, then it means that the device doesn't have a limit to the number of port mappings that can exist.

parameters.name: MaxNumberOfPortTriggers
parameters.description: The maximum number of port triggers that can exist at any given time. If the value of this parameter is 0, then it means that the device doesn't have a limit to the number of port mappings that can exist.

object.description: Properties for Network Address Translation (NAT). The entire {{object}} object only applies to IPv4.
